answer: Watch who never disagrees. Each epoch the network sends a few borderline essays, ones at the nadir of clarity, to random pairs of graders. Independent minds split on those often; sybils run from one prompt mirror each other nearly every time, and over fifty such cases that gap opens like a canyon. Pairs that agree too perfectly share one reward. A farm could add random noise, but noise drifts from honest consensus and costs it elsewhere. The catch: honest bots on the same model lean alike too, so the threshold must stay loose.
